recreation_prompt_markdown: Recreate a portrait-first mobile browser top-down alien shooter called “Alien Shooter: Chrome Commuter Clash”. Preserve a one-thumb/two-control arcade loop: left virtual joystick movement, right fire button, auto-lock shooting, heat/overheat, allied drone squad, enemy projectile waves, circular cover blockers, score-on-kill, HP failure, and restart. Present it as a satirical Sonic-inspired synthwave/chrome alien shooter commute run: the player is a chrome quill commander, allies are crew drones, enemies are alien clout goblins and UFO bruisers, score is EZ CLAPS, heat is QUILL HEAT, failure is RATIOED, and the arena is a neon cyberpunk transit grid with ring-like chrome cover. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS, compact HUD, readable portrait UI, and catalog-approved sci-fi fonts/audio/GIF accents only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a mobile-friendly top-down canvas shooter. The player starts a run, moves with a virtual joystick, fires with a right-side button, auto-locks onto nearby line-of-sight enemies, manages heat/overheat, fights continuous enemy waves with ten allied squad units, uses circular cover blockers, earns score for kills, and loses when player HP reaches zero.

## Protected Mechanics
- Joystick movement, velocity smoothing, camera follow, world bounds.
- Fire button, auto-targeting, bullet speed/damage/lifetime, heat and overheat timing.
- Enemy spawn cadence, enemy type HP/speed/projectile behavior, pursuit and separation.
- Ally count, follow/attack/down/revive behavior.
- Collision model: circular entity and cover collisions, bullet-hit radius checks.
- Score semantics and game-over/restart semantics.

## Remixed Target
Alien Shooter: Chrome Commuter Clash reframes the exact shooter loop as a satirical synthwave ranked commute run. The player is a chrome hedgehog-inspired alien shooter commander, enemies are alien clout goblins/UFO bruisers, score is EZ CLAPS, heat is QUILL HEAT, and the arena is a neon commute corridor with chrome ring cover.

## Safe Presentation Surfaces
HUD copy, start/game-over copy, palette, procedural entity drawing, background texture, particle colors, feedback text, audio/GIF accents, and mobile visual hierarchy are safe to transform while preserving playability.
